notes: Zu fares are charged by distance travelled, not by number of stages or stations.
The 2026-04 image and the 2025-06 'new fares from 1 July 2025' image list identical distance bands and identical new prices, so the two sources corroborate each other.
Urdu note 1 on the 2026 image: a single journey ticket, i.e. a one-trip ticket, costs Rs. 70.
Urdu note 2 on the 2026 image: express buses running on feeder routes charge a fixed fare of Rs. 55.
The page text confirms express routes were excluded from the July 2025 stage increase because they run on a flat fare.
Zu Card price conflict: card page (2025-02-11) says PKR 400, FAQ (2023-07-19) says Rs. 300. Resolved in favour of the newer page.

payload.zu_card_price_note: The site states two different Zu Card prices. The Zu Card purchase and top-up page (last modified 2025-02-11) says PKR 400; the FAQ page (last modified 2023-07-19) still says Rs. 300. The newer page is used. A rider should be told Rs. 400 and warned the published figures disagree.
